meta.provenance: Two sources. The original set was extracted from the client-supplied portfolio PDFs, deduplicated, de-rotated, cropped and re-encoded. The set added on 2026-08-25 came directly from the athlete's own Google Drive archive, downloaded with her rights holder's explicit permission and re-encoded by tools/add_images.py. No image on this site is hotlinked, and no substitute skier has been used anywhere.
meta.rightsWarning: Rights are settled for the images marked rights:"owned", which come from the athlete's own archive. They remain UNCONFIRMED for every image marked rights:"unconfirmed", which were extracted from the portfolio PDFs. One of those extracted frames (p03_00.jpg) carried a visible IMAGO agency watermark, so at least some of that race photography originates from a picture agency, and the cutout used in race-planica-elbrus appears to derive from the same frame. Confirm ownership or licence for the unconfirmed set before launch. Ten images, hero-alps, hero-piste, hero-spray, hero-track, hero-skate, hero-glide, hero-stride, hero-course, hero-tempo and hero-drive, are rights:"ai-generated": it is a generated picture rather than a photograph, and the equipment marks visible in it have not been cleared.
meta.focalPointNote: focal is [x, y] as fractions of width and height, used for object-position so crops keep the subject.
